private_reasoning: Not exported. Only public CLI messages, tools/results, declared decision logs and token counts are retained.
original_markdown_and_python: Kept as .md.txt and .py.txt, to preserve archival text without importing old code or validating its old local links as current docs.
runs_directory_mapping: Original trace/runs copied as trace/executions; avoids the repository runs/ ignore pattern.
metric_interpretation: Historical thinking_seconds is elapsed time outside tool calls, not a record or measurement of private model reasoning. Cached input is part of native input. Reasoning output tokens are part of output. Never sum either subset twice.
legacy_normalizer: normalize.py.txt is a provisional adapter, retained for provenance only; authoritative export is normalize_native.py.txt and reconciled telemetry.
